name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 6 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-01-30, at wavelengths from 1.23 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
